caption: Sint-Lievensmonstertoren, Zierikzee
composition: Unfinished massive brick tower, church nave gone · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Sint-Lievensmonstertoren is a massive decorated brick tower, about 62 metres, started in the fifteenth century and never given its planned spire. The church burned in 1832, so only the tower remains. The top is a low roof, not a needle. It is mainly clear, about 15.6°C, with wind near 8.3 km/h and cloud cover about 34%. The harbour gate is another scene and is not in this frame.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the unfinished Sint-Lievensmonstertoren in Zierikzee at night
